user_text: Summarize the benefits of code review for a small team.
assistant_text:
## Benefits of Code Review for Small Teams

- **Catches bugs early** – Issues found before merging are cheaper to fix
- **Knowledge sharing** – Team members learn each other's approaches and spread domain knowledge
- **Consistency** – Enforces coding standards and keeps the codebase uniform
- **Reduces bus factor** – More than one person understands each part of the code
- **Mentorship** – Junior developers improve faster through feedback
- **Better design** – The act of explaining code often reveals flaws before review even begins
- **Shared ownership** – Everyone feels responsible for code quality, not just the author

For small teams, even lightweight reviews (one reviewer, async) provide significant returns with minimal overhead.
Code review helps small teams catch bugs early, share knowledge, and maintain a consistent, high-quality codebase.

1. **Bug detection** – Errors are caught before merging, reducing costly fixes later.
2. **Knowledge sharing** – Team members stay familiar with all parts of the codebase, reducing dependency on any one person.
Code review fosters a culture of **shared ownership**, where everyone feels collectively responsible for code quality rather than leaving it solely to the author.

user_text: State one risk if reviews are skipped.
assistant_text: Knowledge silos can form, leaving critical parts of the codebase understood by only one person and creating a serious risk if that person leaves.
Track **defect escape rate** — the number of bugs found in production versus those caught during review — to measure how effectively code reviews are improving quality.
Consistent code review is a small investment that pays dividends in quality, collaboration, and long-term maintainability.

• Consistent code review improves quality and catches bugs early.
• It fosters collaboration and shared ownership across the team.
• The long-term maintainability of the codebase is significantly improved.
Code review is a simple practice with outsized benefits for team quality, collaboration, and code health.
Reviews can become a bottleneck if not kept timely and focused, so teams should set clear expectations around turnaround time and scope.
Slow, unfocused reviews can bottleneck teams; set clear expectations always.
Code review boosts quality and collaboration, but works best when kept timely and focused.
